look_here_first: Find upper leaves with broad heartlike bases CLASPING the stem. Individual purple five-lobed flowers occur at leaf axils above an inferior green ovary; tiny selfing closed flowers may occur below. In the typical clasping concept, check a ripe capsule for a seed-release WINDOW around the middle. Never assign a subspecies from flower color alone.

morphology_keys.habit: Small spring annual herb with upright leafy stems.
morphology_keys.leaves: Simple alternate leaves, broad upper blades often strongly clasping at leaf base.
morphology_keys.flower: Individual purple five-lobed fused corolla, with five free stamens above an inferior ovary; upper flowers can be open, lower flowers can be closed and self-pollinating.
morphology_keys.fruit: Many-seeded inferior capsule with side pores; position of openings can separate subspecies, but only with a mature side view.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use leaf clasping and mature capsule side-window position; flower color alone cannot separate.
